about:
Slipyme was founded to deliver top-tier services across various industries. Our mission is to integrate the sectors we operate in and produce high-quality solutions. We are currently active in software, design, and gaming. In software, we carry out projects across a wide range including mobile, desktop, web-based, websites, embedded, electronics, and Arduino.

Our software philosophy is to offer unique solutions through customizable, tailor-made software packages. In design, we specialize in graphic design and create visuals tailored to client needs. We integrate visual assets into our software projects or offer them for sale depending on requirements. We run our workflows with in-house algorithmic tools and AIs. Since clients expect precise outcomes from us, we aim to provide customer-centric solutions in this field as well.

timeline.d: We began operations as Slipyme Software on October 30, 2021. We set off with a team of five and started taking on freelance work.
On March 22, 2022, we adopted the name Slipyme Company and started activating our projects. As we launched our own projects, we gained recognition.
The projects we established started bearing fruit. We began planning the future properly and gained visibility into our path forward.
For three years our team advanced with stability. We grew from a team of 8–10 to 17, left freelance work, and focused on our own projects.
With a swift decision, we paused all projects and kicked off new ones. By the end of 2026, we plan to bring three major projects to life.
